versions.content: Each call to Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame shall step to the next SPN of the ExpandedFreezeFrame for this DemEventMemory. In case no more SPN of the ExpandedFreezeFrame definition is available, the function return value shall be DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT. The out parameter needs not to be valid in this case.
